description: A sleek, contemporary formal dining room with a strong focal wall treatment. The table has a thick cream or white Calacatta marble top on a dark walnut pedestal base. On the table, a slim glass vase holds a loose arrangement of pale peach and cream flowers, and two small ceramic bowls are placed nearby. The area rug is large-scale geometric diamond pattern in grey tones. A heavy dark curtain panel hangs at the far right edge. The mood is polished, gallery-like, and quietly opulent.
